snippet.title: Arbeiter | Reveal Trailer | Gamflix
snippet.description:
Arbeiter is a survival-management game about working-class life. Work to survive, balance hunger, stress, fatigue and wages, organize fellow workers, manage unions, and spread your ideology. Or go your own way.

Minimum:
OS: Windows 10 (64-bit
Processor: 3GHz 4-Core or similar
Memory: 8 GB RAM MB RAM
Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 580
Storage: 8 GB available space
